title: world-class-sports-probability-engine-corpus-audit
universal_lens: A unified framework integrating stochastic state-space models, conformal prediction, and Bayesian inference to calibrate latent athletic performance across sport-specific domains. Conformal predictive inference underpins GSE's probabilistic decision-making, bridging epistemic uncertainty and market pricing through quantile-clamped intervals.
gsi_mapping: GSI leverages ensemble Kalman filtering and Brier loss optimization to refine probabilistic forecasts, ensuring calibrated outputs through conformal quantile regression and martingale-based skill testing. Bayesian posterior inference with conformal prediction ensures finite-sample coverage for GSI's probabilistic models, particularly in low-data regimes.
gse_mapping: GSE employs shadow evaluation loops and state-transition verification gates to maintain system integrity while enabling real-time adaptation via Hawkes processes and robust Kelly sizing. GSE employs state-transition logic with shadow pipelines and Hawkes processes to model dynamic performance and market feedback loops.

primitives.name: Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **TeamStrengthFilter:** Ensemble Transform Kalman Filter (ETKF) modeling latent team strength as a sequential Monte Carlo particle filter.

primitives.name: Hawkes Steam Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Hawkes steam detection:** `hawkes-steam.ts` — per-side exponential-decay Hawkes self-exciting process with online intensity updates to detect clustered, informed betting pressure ("steam"), separating organic background volatility from momentum-driven line movement.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'\\lambda(t)': 'Instantaneous betting intensity at time t (events/second)', '\\mu': 'Baseline intensity (events/second)', '\\alpha': 'Excitation coefficient (dimensionless)', '\\beta': 'Decay rate (1/second)', 't_i': 'Event arrival times (seconds)'}
primitives.assumptions: Betting events follow a self-exciting point process with exponential decay kernel.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \(\alpha \beta > 1\), the process becomes explosive and unstable.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's state transition logic where betting steam triggers adaptive model reweighting and risk recalibration.

primitives.name: Forecast-Skill E-process
primitives.verbatim_quote: - **Forecast-Skill E-process:** `forecast-skill-eprocess.ts` in the LiveOrchestrator — an anytime-valid sequential likelihood-ratio martingale based on Ville's inequality, testing H0: model probabilities are no better than market consensus.

primitives.assumptions: Model probabilities are sequentially testable under null hypothesis of market equivalence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When model probability diverges significantly from market consensus, M_t grows without bound.

layer2.mapping: An isomorphism to GSI’s Bayesian updating mechanism, where the e-process signals when model confidence exceeds market calibration thresholds.
layer2.telemetry: Martingale deviation, p-value threshold crossing, cumulative log-likelihood ratio

primitives.name: Quantile-Clamping Ban
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Quantile-clamping ban + fail-closed conformal policy (CQR).** GSE publishes SPREAD/TOTAL picks; any interval the engine shows must carry honest finite-sample coverage.
primitives.assumptions: The system must maintain honest finite-sample coverage for all predictions. No clamping of quantiles is allowed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When quantile estimates exceed valid statistical bounds due to small sample sizes or adversarial inputs.

primitives.name: Venn-Abers Multiprobability Bounds
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Venn-Abers multiprobability bounds for moneylines.** GSE's SPREAD/MONEYLINE picks are binary outcomes; the audit's argument that CQR math is invalid for Y∈{0,1} and that Venn-Abers [p_0, p_1] with a No-Bet gate on p_1-p_0 > 0.20 captures epistemic uncertainty is the cleanest stated calibration discipline for the binary side.
primitives.assumptions: Binary outcomes (Y ∈ {0,1}) require specialized probability bounds. Epistemic uncertainty is bounded by a threshold on difference between probabilities.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When binary outcome models exhibit high variance or insufficient calibration in early-season data.

layer2.mapping: Derives from GSI’s core Bayesian updating but applied specifically to binary classification tasks with bounded uncertainty.
layer2.telemetry: Calibration error and sharpness of predicted probability intervals.
